entries.name: EVENT_TYPES
entries.description: Object of all event type string literals. Values: ORDER_CREATED='order.created', ORDER_CONFIRMED='order.confirmed', ORDER_SHIPPED='order.shipped', ORDER_CANCELLED='order.cancelled', ORDER_DELIVERED='order.delivered', ORDER_RETURN_REQUESTED='order.return_requested', ORDER_RETURN_APPROVED='order.return_approved', ORDER_RETURN_REJECTED='order.return_rejected', ORDER_RETURN_REFUNDED='order.return_refunded', PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED='payment.authorized', PAYMENT_FAILED='payment.failed', PAYMENT_REFUNDED='payment.refunded', PRODUCT_CREATED='product.created', PRODUCT_UPDATED='product.updated', PRODUCT_DELETED='product.deleted', REVIEW_CREATED='review.created', SEARCH_EXECUTED='search.executed'

entries.name: TOPICS
entries.description: Object of Kafka topic strings. Values: ORDER_EVENTS='order.events', PAYMENT_EVENTS='payment.events', PRODUCT_EVENTS='product.events', SEARCH_EVENTS='search.events'

entries.name: CONSUMER_GROUPS
entries.description: Object of Kafka consumer group strings. Values: NOTIFICATION_WORKER='notification-worker-group', PRODUCT_SERVICE='product-service-group', PAYMENT_SERVICE='payment-service-group', ORDER_SERVICE='order-service-group', ANALYTICS_SERVICE='analytics-service-group', SEARCH_INDEXER='search-indexer', LOYALTY_SERVICE='loyalty-service-group'

entries.name: BaseEventSchema
entries.description: Zod schema for common event fields. Fields: type (literal enum of order/payment types), orderId (positive int), userId (positive int), correlationId (UUID v4 string), timestamp (ISO 8601 datetime string)

entries.name: OrderItemSchema
entries.description: Reusable Zod schema for order line items. Fields: productId (positive int), quantity (positive int), price (positive number)

entries.name: OrderCreatedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.created'. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: positive number, shippingAddress?: string, couponCode?: string (min 1), discountType?: 'percentage'|'fixed_amount', discountValue?: positive number, discountAmount?: non-negative number, subtotal?: positive number, pointsRedeemed?: non-negative int, pointsDiscountAmount?: non-negative number, pointsRedemptionRate?: positive int }

entries.name: OrderConfirmedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.confirmed'. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: positive number, paymentId?: string }

entries.name: OrderShippedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.shipped'. data: { trackingNumber?: string, carrier?: string, estimatedDelivery?: ISO 8601 datetime string }

entries.name: OrderCancelledSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.cancelled'. data: { reason: string (min 1), cancelledBy: 'user'|'system'|'admin', refundAmount?: non-negative number, items?: OrderItem[], totalAmount?: positive number, previousStatus?: 'created'|'confirmed', pointsRedeemed?: non-negative int }

entries.name: OrderDeliveredSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.delivered'. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: positive number, total?: non-negative number (post-discount total actually paid) }

entries.name: OrderReturnRequestedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.return_requested'. data: { category: string (min 1), reason?: string (min 1), items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: positive number }

entries.name: OrderReturnApprovedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.return_approved'. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: positive number }

entries.name: OrderReturnRejectedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.return_rejected'. data: { adminReason: string (min 1) }

entries.name: OrderReturnRefundedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='order.return_refunded'. data: { refundAmount: positive number, pointsRedeemed?: non-negative int }

entries.name: PaymentAuthorizedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='payment.authorized'. data: { transactionId: string (min 1), amount: positive number, currency: string (min 1) }

entries.name: PaymentFailedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='payment.failed'. data: { reason: string (min 1), retryable: boolean }

entries.name: PaymentRefundedSchema
entries.description: Zod schema extending BaseEventSchema. type='payment.refunded'. data: { amount: positive number, currency: string (min 1) }

entries.name: ProductCreatedSchema
entries.description: Product event schema (different structure from order/payment — uses 'payload' not 'data', includes 'eventId', not tied to orderId/userId). Fields: eventId (UUID v4), type='product.created', timestamp (ISO 8601). payload: { id (UUID v4), name, description, price, averageRating, categoryIds: string[], categoryNames: string[], tags: string[], inStock: boolean, imageUrl?: string, createdAt (ISO 8601), updatedAt (ISO 8601) }

entries.name: ProductUpdatedSchema
entries.description: Same structure as ProductCreatedSchema but type='product.updated'

entries.name: ProductDeletedSchema
entries.description: Product delete event. Fields: eventId (UUID v4), type='product.deleted', timestamp (ISO 8601). payload: { id (UUID v4), deletedAt (ISO 8601) }

entries.name: ReviewCreatedSchema
entries.description: Review event schema (standalone product.events topic — same envelope as product events, not order/payment). Fields: eventId (UUID v4), type='review.created', timestamp (ISO 8601). payload: { reviewId: positive int, productId: positive int, userId: positive int, rating: int 1–5, timestamp: ISO 8601 datetime (when review was created) }

entries.name: SearchExecutedSchema
entries.description: Search analytics event. Fields: eventId (UUID v4), type='search.executed', timestamp (ISO 8601). payload: { query: string, resultCount: number, facetsApplied: Record<string, string[]>, userId?: string, responseTimeMs: number }

entries.name: createOrderEvent
entries.description: Factory with type-safe overloads for all 9 order event types. Params: (type: OrderEventType, params: { orderId: number, userId: number, correlationId?: string, timestamp?: string, data: <event-specific-data> }). Returns typed event object. Auto-generates correlationId (UUID v4) and timestamp (ISO 8601) if omitted. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createPaymentEvent
entries.description: Factory with type-safe overloads for all 3 payment event types. Params: (type: 'payment.authorized'|'payment.failed'|'payment.refunded', params: { orderId: number, userId: number, correlationId?: string, timestamp?: string, data: <event-specific-data> }). Returns typed event object. Auto-generates correlationId and timestamp if omitted. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createProductCreatedEvent
entries.description: Params: (payload: { id: string (UUID), name: string, description: string, price: number, averageRating: number, categoryIds: string[], categoryNames: string[], tags: string[], inStock: boolean, imageUrl?: string, createdAt: string, updatedAt: string }). Returns ProductCreatedEvent. Auto-generates eventId (UUID v4) and timestamp. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createProductUpdatedEvent
entries.description: Same signature as createProductCreatedEvent. Returns ProductUpdatedEvent. Auto-generates eventId and timestamp. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createProductDeletedEvent
entries.description: Params: (payload: { id: string (UUID), deletedAt: string (ISO 8601) }). Returns ProductDeletedEvent. Auto-generates eventId and timestamp. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createReviewCreatedEvent
entries.description: Params: (payload: { reviewId: number (positive int), productId: number (positive int), userId: number (positive int), rating: number (int 1–5), timestamp: string (ISO 8601) }). Returns ReviewCreatedEvent. Auto-generates eventId (UUID v4) and envelope timestamp. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createSearchExecutedEvent
entries.description: Params: (payload: { query: string, resultCount: number, facetsApplied: Record<string, string[]>, userId?: string, responseTimeMs: number }). Returns SearchExecutedEvent. Auto-generates eventId and timestamp. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: validateEvent
entries.description: Safe universal validator. Params: (event: unknown). Returns { success: true, data: AllEvents } | { success: false, error: Error }. Never throws. Routes to correct schema by event.type discriminator (handles all order, payment, product, review, and search event types). Handles null/undefined and missing type field with descriptive error messages. Use this for consumer-side validation.
